sloka: निवेद्यतां ततो राज्ञे मानुषी सा मृतेति ह ।नात्र कश्चन सन्देहः खादतेति स वक्ष्यति ।। ५.२२.३७।।।।
transliteration: nivedyatāṁ tato rājñe mānuṣī sā mṛteti ha ।nātra kaścana sandehaḥ khādateti sa vakṣyati ।। 5.22.37।।।।

translations.english: "By adopting means favourable or contrary to her will or through persuasion or coercion or through reward or punishment, draw Vaidehi's mind towards me." (said Ravana).
